Definition: Jehovah-Tsidkenu, a symbolical epithet of the Messiah and of Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Jehovah-Tsidkenu is two Hebrew words joined as one name, 'the LORD' and 'our righteousness'. In Jeremiah 23:6, And this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS, and it appears again in Jeremiah 33:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the LORD our righteousness is the whole gospel in a name: my standing before God is not my own doing, it is His.
